source_span: If we let the probability of randomly selecting a yellow jelly bean be $x$, then we have \begin{align*}0.2+0.5+x&=1\\\Rightarrow0.7+x&=1\\\Rightarrow{x}&=1-0.7\\\Rightarrow{x}&=0.3\end{align*} Therefore, the probability of randomly selecting a yellow jelly bean from this jar is $\boxed{0.3}$.
